parent_evidence.G7R: trace curriculum improved list/memory but failed primary gate and arithmetic/code stayed near zero

hypothesis: Ordering the exact same training minibatch multiset from easier to harder algorithmic cases improves arithmetic+code free-generation exact accuracy versus a deterministic shuffled order, without changing parameters, objective, total examples or optimizer updates.

arms.shuffled_control: same exact 2000 pre-sampled minibatches deterministically permuted across update positions

split_rule: fresh canonical groups denied against G5S+G7R+G11R+G12 before rendering; arithmetic/list commutative permutations canonicalize; memory preserves per-key chronology; G12 held never becomes training data
optimizer: AdamW lr .001 warmup100 cosine-to15%, betas(.9,.95), wd .01, clip1
objective: strict final-only F=<integer>+EOS; no textual trace target; no solver/case/gold at inference
primary_metric: mean arithmetic+code_trace IID exact across seeds
compute: same exact minibatch multiset, same tensor shapes per batch, parameters, total examples and optimizer updates. Different ordering means examples occur at different learning rates by design; record wall time/FLOPs/latency.
selection: fixed step2000 only; validation/held never select checkpoint or hyperparameters
scope: small optimization/curriculum mechanism screen; not300-800M and not Qwen parity
